notes:
## Minecraft 26.1.2 / 26.2 compatibility
Fixes the Minecraft 26.2 startup crash in SidebarMixin by removing the version-fragile Gui.getFont shadow and using the client font directly. The mod metadata supports Minecraft **26.1.2 through 26.2.x**. This release publishes the exact JAR from the successful CI build on the verified release commit.

## Verification
All unit and integration checks in the selected build passed, including the actual Fabric client rendering smoke test and CustomScoreboard, SkyHanni, and combined integration tests. The selected artifact is the exact tested JAR, not a rebuild. Test fixtures are excluded from the published JAR. CI client tests target Minecraft 26.1.2; the 26.2-specific fix addresses the reported 26.2 startup crash, but CI does not run a separate authenticated 26.2 client.

## Installation
Install **coins-to-money-1.2.5.jar** and remove older Coins to Money versions first. Existing settings are retained. CustomScoreboard, SkyHanni and Kotlin remain optional and are not bundled.

Requires **Minecraft 26.1.2 through 26.2.x**, **Java 25**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, and **Fabric API 0.155.3+26.1.2**. Mod Menu is optional. **K** opens settings; **O** toggles conversion.
